note: MEASURE WITHOUT PROJECT DEPENDENCIES -- 1379 -> 1297. The 1379 this replaces was reproducible in no environment at all: at 927d5d7ef92, the commit that set it, a cold run measures 1384 with the project deps installed and 1297 without, and the same pair holds at HEAD. The gate is exact-mode, so CI has been failing on every push to 19.0-marin and every in-scope PR since, reporting 1297 against a floor of 1379. Root cause is an environment mismatch, not a warm cache: py_typecheck.yml installs ONLY mypy and reasons explicitly that ignore_missing_imports makes the runtime deps unnecessary, so CI resolves lxml/psycopg/dateutil to Any while a developer venv resolves them to real stubs. That gap is 87 errors, and a floor measured in an activated p314o19m -- which the previous recipe, warning only about cache warmth, invited -- can never be reproduced by the gate enforcing it. Reproduce this number the way CI does: python -m venv /tmp/mypyenv && /tmp/mypyenv/bin/pip install mypy==1.19.1, then run it from a CLEAN checkout (git worktree add --detach, since the shared tree usually carries other sessions work) with --no-incremental and the six -p packages. mypy stays at 1.19.1 here; 2.3.0 measures 1293 in the same environment and is a separate change.
